by.quote: Glossing is inconsistent: tsuka, shodan and 水 are glossed; fusuma, kinpira, karaage and taiyaki aren't.
The inline-gloss pattern repeats (see #10): "shodan (first dan)" in speech and "水 (Wednesday)" in narration. Three in one chapter makes it a house style, and it pulls me out of the voice every time.

items.why: Reader2 names the unexplained food and house terms the author couldn't follow; reader3 touches shodan but objects to glossing rather than asking for more.
